description: Volume-anomaly observations across newly created BSC pools, from a 15-minute monitoring sweep: pools whose hourly volume spiked vs the prior hour (floor $1,000 and 100x), with pool name, hourly volume, spike ratio, price move and source link. Machine-readable monitoring feed for agents tracking early on-chain activity. Observation data only — thresholds uncalibrated; not signals, not financial advice. Refreshed every 15 minutes; data age disclosed in every response. Paid per call via x402: $0.005 USDC on Base — the payment challenge is returned automatically; x402-capable clients retry with payment.
name: bsc_alerts
